Name: Shaved Harvey
Author: n0stardust
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]I personally dislike facial hair so wanted to removed it. could not find a mod that kept the original base so i made it myself. to save everyone time i will make it a mod for everyone to enjoy. i hope I'm not the only one who wants this mod.[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]This re-texture only effects the portraits of Harvey. the small sprite already looks like he doesn't have a mustache so i see no need to edit that. [/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]All portraits have been done.[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]step 1: open steam -> browse local files[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]step 2: click the "Content" folder[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]step 3: click the "portraits" folder[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]step 4: copy the xnb files into the folder. make sure it overwrites the current file![/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]step 5: open game and enjoy[/size][/color]

[size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Remove Mod instructions[/color] [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]step 1: open steam -> browse local files
step 2: click the "Content" folder
step 3: click the "portraits" folder[/color]
step 4: remove Harvey.xnb, Harvey_beach.xnb and  Harvey_winter.xnb
step 5: go to steam properties of the game -> installed files -> verify integrity of game files.
this will check for missing files and re-download the old Harvey sprites for you

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Stardew valley[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]don't know 100% but i think you don't need SMAPI. (but you probably already have it anyway since your here to mod stardew) [/size][/color]
